title: Drornok Tok Vo'Lok
summary: Clear the pond creatures to call Drornok Tok Vo’Lok, then handle two additional frog waves during the fight.
overview: Clear the pond creatures to call Drornok Tok Vo’Lok, then handle two additional frog waves during the fight.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Defeat the required loktoles, amphans and toads around the pond to summon Drornok.
Drornok repopulates the pond when he appears. Establish a controlled approach before pulling him.
At 97% and 50% health, he summons two more pond creatures directly onto the tank’s hate target. Prepare an add tank at both thresholds.
If he heals to 99%, his summoned combat adds are cleared and both health triggers reset.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
